These compounds are all implicated in pathways that involve Gamma-secretase, suggesting a possible mechanism by which the initial compound may interact with or influence its activity. The evidence is consistent across multiple paths, indicating a plausible biological connection, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated. The strength of the evidence is supported by multiple high-scoring pathways, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct relationship.
